# LinkSave (https://linksaves.com/)

> LinkSave is a fast, free, and secure online YouTube video downloader, YouTube Shorts downloader, and MP3 audio converter. It allows users to download videos in HD 1080p, 4K, 720p MP4, and extract 320kbps MP3 audio with no registration or software installation required.

## Key Features
- **YouTube Video Downloader**: High-speed MP4 downloads up to 4K / 1080p resolution.
- **YouTube Shorts Downloader**: Download short-form videos cleanly without quality loss.
- **YouTube to MP3 Converter**: Instant high-quality audio extraction (up to 320kbps).
- **YouTube to MP4 Converter**: Dedicated MP4 video conversion tool.
- **Multi-Platform Support**: Works seamlessly on Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, Linux, and Smart TVs.
- **No Registration Required**: Completely free to use without creating an account or providing personal details.
- **Fast & Secure**: Direct web browser downloads with SSL encryption and zero background software installs.
